_comment: Rule R5: the clichés house-style.md forbids. `strings` are matched case-insensitively as plain substrings; `patterns` are regular expressions carrying an `id` and a `message`. Extend this freely — it is config, not code. False-credential claims are deliberately NOT here: they depend on your name and on what profile-meta.json says you hold, so R4 builds those checks from your own data instead of from a fixed list (D013 — a document may never claim an unawarded qualification, and that rule is never negotiable).
